source.map: City of Portland Johnson Creek Basin plan district (PCC 33.537, Map 537-1) and its subdistricts, as Portland Maps publishes them; flood and trail layers as listed in inputs
source.says: The South subdistrict land-class density (33.537.140.E) and the Flood Risk Area (33.537.160) reach these sites; both govern land divisions and planned developments only, so they reach the pod as four townhouses on unit lots and not as one building on the one lot

inputs.taxlots: quadfit s2_lots (data/quadfit_2026-10-30_dd_c6, Metro RLIS taxlots), the lot shapes the screen asks
inputs.subdistricts: plan-subdistricts.geojson, PLDIST JC SUBDIST SOUTH and FLOOD RISK (BPS_Zoning_Code_Layers layer 1, fetched 2026-10-22)
inputs.retrace_taxlots: quadfit s2_lots (data/quadfit s2_lots.parquet of 2026-07-24, Metro RLIS taxlots), used only to take lots out

source.method: Split 2026-11-08 (FOLLOWUPS 58) from the 2026-11-08 johnson-creek-unmeasured-lots tracing, nothing added to it. Taxlots as before: quadfit s2_lots of quadfit_2026-10-30_dd_c6, lots 10% or more inside the plan district. This file: the old tracing within 0.5 ft of every lot with 1 sq ft or more in the South subdistrict or the Flood Risk Area subdistrict (plan-subdistricts.geojson). Its lots near the Springwater Corridor stay in the unmeasured tracing too. 2026-11-09: when the corridor tracing was re-traced on the corridor parcel, what the 2026-11-08 corridor tracing covered inside the South subdistrict or the Flood Risk Area was added here (32.4 acres, street and lot-edge slivers; no lot's answer changed), so the two tracings together still cover both subdistricts.
